$comment: What an app generated from this template must still replace or wire before it can ship. Shared capabilities are never placeholders: each one is an exact published pin. packages/release/template-contract.test.mjs fails when a listed marker is gone from its file, when the template carries a placeholder marker that is not listed, and when a declaredOnly owner is wired in source but still listed.

replace.with: the app's update manifest URL (the release provider's public host)
the suite updater public key, copied from a shipped app (never generate keys); right-release.config.json reads distribution.updaterPublicKey from this file
the full icon set, from `pnpm exec tauri icon <approved-master.png>` (adds icon.icns); delete this README
the app's public legal host, then `pnpm exec legal-snapshot`
reviewed product schedule text (refunds, plans), then `pnpm exec legal-snapshot`
reviewed privacy notice text for what the app actually receives, then `pnpm exec legal-snapshot`
the app's registered appKey, licence host and Ed25519 public key (bogusyogi/rightkit#272) for a licensed app; a free app keeps None
the approved palette from /brand <code>, then `pnpm brand:sync`

declaredOnly.blockedOn: the engine opens no database until the app has product state
